Bench: Pankaj Purohit

 Wpcrl No.575 of 2025
 Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. M.K. Goyal, learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. Mr. B.C. Joshi, learned AGA along with Mr. Vikas Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for respondent no.5.

4. By means of the present writ petition, petitioners have put to challenge the FIR No.0044 of 2025 dated 20.03.2025, under Sections 120-B, 323, 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504 & 506 IPC, registered at Dalanwala, District Dehradun.

5. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that the FIR has been lodged by respondent no.5 due to retaliation of petitioner no.1 filing a WPCRL No.139 of 2025, Amit Kumar Meegi vs.
State & others, wherein the allegations have been made against the SSP, Dehradun, who allegedly was raising constructions over the property of the petitioners.

entities.text:

State & others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Per contra, learned State Counsel submits that allegations against the petitioners are very serious in FIR.
Petitioners are not cooperating with the investigation.
7. Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the view that matter requires deliberation.

8. Let counter affidavit(s) be filed by the respondent(s) within a period of six weeks.
9. List on 19.08.2025.
10.

Till the next date of listing, no coercive measures shall be taken against the petitioners, pursuant WPCRL/575/2025 on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37721069/
1 to the impugned FIR.

However, it is provided that petitioners shall cooperate with the investigation,
if they will not cooperate with the investigation, the interim order passed by this Court shall stand vacated on an application moved by the respondent/State in future.
11. Interim relief application (IA No.1/2025) stands disposed of accordingly.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 10.06.2025 AK WPCRL/575/2025 on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37721069/
